sections.theory:
To make better governance effective, the following institutions have so far been established:

1. National Security Council

2. Federal Cabinet

3. Provincial Governors

4. Provincial Cabinets

5. National Reconstruction Bureau

6. National Accountability Bureau

7. National Monitoring System

8. National Command Authority

Obstacles in the way of good governance and reform

In Pakistan the following obstacles stand in the way of good governance.

Lack of education

Even after so much time has passed since independence, there is a lack of education in Pakistan, because of which political, economic and social problems are increasing day by day. According to the latest Economic Survey, 58% of people in Pakistan are literate. This rate is very low by international standards.

Absence of standard planning

In Pakistan not only have experiments been taking place in the field of politics, but economic planning here has also been defective. Its effect fell on both the people and the rulers, as a result of which the concept of the welfare state faded.

Increase in the number of parties

In Pakistan not only is the number of political parties increasing day by day, but the old parties too have fallen victim to break-up for various reasons. Political leaders do not take interest in solving the problems of the people, the consequence of which all the people have to suffer.

Deviation from federal principles

Pakistan is a federal state, but the ruling class kept deviating from federal principles according to the constitution, and instead of making federal democratic principles effective and active, every ruler kept using the constitution and the government for his own political and personal purposes, because of which an atmosphere of chaos kept arising in the country.

Religious extremism

For some time religious extremism has been increasing in Pakistan, because of which sectarianism has taken hold. Because of all these things the country kept growing weaker politically and economically.

Not upholding the law

In principle all people are equal in the eyes of the law, but in our country obtaining justice and upholding the law in practice is a very difficult matter. The judicial system is extremely complex and expensive, in which there is a great waste of money and time.

Remedy

The following measures are necessary for good governance.

پارٹیوں کی تعداد میں اضافہ

پاکستان میں نہ صرف سیاسی پارٹیوں کی تعداد میں دن بدن اضافہ ہو رہا ہے بلکہ پرانی پارٹیاں بھی مختلف وجوہات کی بناء پر ٹوٹ پھوٹ کا شکار ہیں۔ سیاسی لیڈر عوام کے مسائل حل کرنے میں دلچسپی نہیں لیتے، جس کا نتیجہ تمام عوام کو بھگتنا پڑتا ہے۔

وفاقی اصولوں سے انحراف

پاکستان ایک وفاقی مملکت ہے لیکن حکمران طبقہ آئین کے مطابق وفاقی اصولوں سے انحراف کرتا رہا اور بجائے وفاقی جمہوری اصولوں کو مؤثر اور فعال بنانے کے ہر حکمران اپنے سیاسی اور ذاتی مقاصد کے لیے آئین اور حکومت کو استعمال کرتا رہا۔ جس سے ملک میں افراتفری کی فضا پیدا ہوتی رہی۔

مذہبی انتہا پسندی

پاکستان میں کچھ عرصے سے مذہبی انتہا پسندی بڑھ رہی ہے۔ جس کی وجہ سے فرقہ واریت نے زور پکڑا ہے۔ ان تمام باتوں کی وجہ سے ملک سیاسی اور معاشی طور پر کمزور ہوتا چلا گیا۔

قانون کی پاسداری نہ کرنا

اصولی طور پر قانون کی نظر میں تمام لوگ یکساں ہوتے ہیں لیکن ہمارے ملک میں عملی طور پر انصاف کا حصول اور قانون کی پاسداری بڑی مشکل بات ہے۔ عدالتی نظام نہایت ہی پیچیدہ اور مہنگا ہے۔ جس میں پیسے اور وقت کا کافی ضیاع ہوتا ہے۔

To make better governance effective, the following institutions have so far been established:

1. National Security Council

2. Federal Cabinet

3. Provincial Governors

4. Provincial Cabinets

5. National Reconstruction Bureau

6. National Accountability Bureau

7. National Monitoring System

8. National Command Authority

Obstacles in the way of good governance and reform

In Pakistan the following obstacles stand in the way of good governance.

Lack of education

Even after so much time has passed since independence, there is a lack of education in Pakistan, because of which political, economic and social problems are increasing day by day. According to the latest Economic Survey, 58% of people in Pakistan are literate. This rate is very low by international standards.

Absence of standard planning

In Pakistan not only have experiments been taking place in the field of politics, but economic planning here has also been defective. Its effect fell on both the people and the rulers, as a result of which the concept of the welfare state faded.

Increase in the number of parties

In Pakistan not only is the number of political parties increasing day by day, but the old parties too have fallen victim to break-up for various reasons. Political leaders do not take interest in solving the problems of the people, the consequence of which all the people have to suffer.

Deviation from federal principles

Pakistan is a federal state, but the ruling class kept deviating from federal principles according to the constitution, and instead of making federal democratic principles effective and active, every ruler kept using the constitution and the government for his own political and personal purposes, because of which an atmosphere of chaos kept arising in the country.

Religious extremism

For some time religious extremism has been increasing in Pakistan, because of which sectarianism has taken hold. Because of all these things the country kept growing weaker politically and economically.

Not upholding the law

In principle all people are equal in the eyes of the law, but in our country obtaining justice and upholding the law in practice is a very difficult matter. The judicial system is extremely complex and expensive, in which there is a great waste of money and time.

Remedy

The following measures are necessary for good governance.
